preferred_rationale: Consistent across the application description on the Falkirk Council portal ('300MW Demand Utility Capacity'), developer material and journalism.
notes: Application description on the portal is 'Construction of an AI Data Centre with 300MW Demand Utility Capacity'. Whether 300 MW is IT load or total grid import is not stated; treated as demand/grid import.
200 emergency backup diesel generators with a 48-hour fuel supply, tested monthly/quarterly/annually. Aggregate MW rating not disclosed.

Campus would connect to Apatura's separately consented battery energy storage (BESS) site about two miles to the north; that BESS is a separate project and its MW rating is not part of this application.
